outcome.technical: 1) Link decode (plugins/audit/scripts/ui/report/page-state.js): new offeredBy(bar, attr, sel) reads the values a control offers off its chips and select options (minus the synthetic multi option), array membership only so constructor/toString are never offered; dateFieldTakes(v) asks a detached clone of the page's date field whether it would hold the value (a date input empties itself on a non-date); every FILTER_AXES decode now keeps only offered values (ps, m, tev, tevf, au whole; a per tag, deduplicated, keeping real tags beside bogus ones; from/to per end). Search stays free text. Dropped values are never applied, and the first refresh rewrites the link without them. Status hidden by the view (#!ps=done in Active): viewForStatus switches viewMode and the View select to the first view VIEWS declares that holds the status's segment (done -> Archived). Reason is in the code comment: the link writer never emits that pairing, so the sender asked for those phases; dropping it gives a different filter than named, and keeping it presses a hidden chip over an empty table. Switching the visible View select is the only answer where every control agrees with the rows. 2) Side-nav: markSpy no longer computes its own fold (layers + 4px). New landingLine(el) reads each target's resolved scroll-margin-top (+1px rounding slack), the same [id] rule a jump uses (shell.css: calc(var(--sticky-2) + var(--sp-2))), so there is one source. shell.css only gains a comment naming the reader. 3) Browser gate (tools/check-report-interactive.mjs): hr0-hr4 (link keys read from the shipped script's own keys: [...] registry; each loaded alone with nosuch-value/constructor/toString, or notadate/2026-02-30/constructor for dates, must open exactly like no link: phases, usage rows, pressed chips, fields, More-filters count, Clear; hr2 is the allow half, an offered value comes back on, so a mis-derived key or a decode that drops everything is red; hr3: every status chip's link presses it and draws only its phases whatever the default view) and sn1/sn2 (every visible side-nav entry clicked at 1512, 1000 and 390px must light itself; an entry the document ends too early to land is reported as a note, not judged). 4) tests/test_render_report.py: two source pins that named the old fold constant were updated on purpose (shell marker pin now wants landingLine(el) and scrollMarginTop; st2 now wants no const fold). 5) README row for page-state.js updated. 6) Followers: sh examples/report.sh (acme html + md; the md change is only the generated timestamp), docs/index.html byte copy, docs/demo-large.html via the --how recipe, node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (dark.png + captured-at.json changed; exit 0).
